purpose: Teach: 高圧/無秩序/慈悲/漂流/召喚/同化/戒め/惨事

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、高血圧症は高圧的な口調で説明しないよう医療チームで気を付けます
lines.en: Ren, we make sure our medical team is careful not to explain hypertension in an overbearing tone.
lines.style: Clear, measured delivery. Opens with Ren's name, warm but professional. Steady pace, like explaining something important but not urgent. Slight emphasis on 'careful' — a point of pride for the hospital.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、無秩序な医療体制を医療チームで整備しました
lines.en: Yes, we've reorganized our medical systems to reduce confusion in our patient care.
lines.style: Even, reassuring tone. Speaks with quiet confidence about a completed improvement. No rush. The satisfaction of work done well, delivered without self-congratulation.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療の慈悲の精神を、貴院、大事にされてますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital really does prioritize that spirit of compassion in medicine, doesn't it, Doctor?
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly wondering. Ren pauses internally before speaking — testing the observation. Genuine appreciation, but the tone searches for confirmation. Respectful distance maintained.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、漂流者救助時の医療体制を医療チームで整えます
lines.en: Yes, we prepare our medical team to handle emergencies for people in crisis situations.
lines.style: Calm affirmation. Speaks as though describing routine preparation, which to her it is. Quiet authority. A small nod in the voice to the weight of the responsibility, without dramatizing it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 患者さんの召喚状対応を、貴院、なさったそうですね、先生
lines.en: I heard your hospital responded well when patients needed help navigating difficult situations, didn't you, Doctor?
lines.style: Curious but careful. Ren is asking something genuine without presuming. The tone is almost tentative — wanting to understand more. Respectful of her expertise and experience.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、外来文化との同化過程の影響を医療チームで研究します
lines.en: Yes, our medical team studies how cultural differences affect care so we can serve everyone better.
lines.style: Patient, matter-of-fact explanation. She speaks of ongoing work, not finished work. There's a quiet dedication in the pace — methodical, thoughtful. No apology, just commitment.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療事故後の戒めの言葉を、貴院、発信されてますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital sends out meaningful lessons after medical incidents, doesn't it, Doctor?
lines.style: Respectful wonder in the tone. Ren recognizes something rare — a place that learns from mistakes without hiding them. The question is sincere, not testing. Gentle curiosity.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、大惨事時の医療対応を医療チームで備えております
lines.en: Yes, we keep our medical team ready to respond effectively in large-scale emergencies.
lines.style: Steady, resolute tone. The closing affirmation — slightly closer, more intimate than the others. Still professional, but the listener feels her quiet confidence in her team's preparedness. A note of care underneath.
